title: I am working on post-apocalypse card game
author: LegendaryJohnny
selftext:
I created post-apocalypse card game with 6 heroes, around 150 cards, 4 skins - full graphics, pixel art and 2 'notepad' which allows you to play at work without drawing attention. Game is satisfying and there is no postapo wasteland settings in any card game as far as I know, maybe Doomtrooper is close to it.

I was always fan of card games, spent 100s of hours playing Hearthstone (which is visible in this game, mechanics and some cards are inspired). But I am also fan of post apocalypse settings and old Fallout games (some mechanics in the game inspired by old Fallouts like targeting limbs).

I want you to try it, give me feedback, help me balance cards. If you DM me I will send you ingame currency called Bullets for free to unlock all. Have fun!

[www.atomicbunch.com](http://www.atomicbunch.com)
